title: Connection Storm Survival
summary: When max_connections is exhausted, new clients fail while existing sessions may continue consuming resources. Recovery starts with an admin connection, pg_stat_activity triage, terminating safe idle sessions, reducing app concurrency, and adding pooling or backpressure after the incident.
learning_objectives: Explain the operational purpose of Connection Storm Survival.
Collect PostgreSQL evidence before proposing remediation.
Describe verification and rollback for the administrative action.
reflection_prompts: What evidence would you attach to an incident review?
Which part of the remediation has the largest operational blast radius?
